game: The Last of Us Part II
observations: Traversal cues cover gaps, ledges, squeeze spaces, crouch areas, interactions, pickups, glass, and control changes.
Combat cues cover incoming attacks, targeting, and confirmed hits.
Enhanced Listen Mode uses source-positioned cues and pitch differences for elevation.
Cue volume, effects, dialogue, music, cinematic audio, narration, vibration, and visual alternatives are configurable separately.
inferences: Critical information can be represented through multiple coordinated channels without requiring every player to enable all of them.
Artificial cue vocabularies benefit from a replayable glossary and stable semantics.
limits: Feature availability does not prove equivalent usability for every player.
This record does not evaluate narrative, combat balance, or default presentation.
